# `/constitution`

> Generate or update the project constitution from the PRD

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/constitution.md — do not edit -->

Derives the non-negotiable project principles from the PRD, and offers a portable `AGENTS.md`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/constitution` |
| **Reads** | `PRD.md`, `CLAUDE.md` |
| **Writes** | `specs/constitution.md`, optionally `AGENTS.md` |
| **Gates** | You approve the principles; `AGENTS.md` is written only if you agree. |
| **Next** | `/design` (UI projects) or `/roadmap` |
| **Tools** | `Bash(ls:*), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob` |
